description: A compact master clock giving one pulse per quarter note, run from its own tempo or locked to an external clock, with half and double speed outputs

params.text: Sets the internal tempo in whole steps from 30 to 300 BPM; it is ignored while a clock is patched to EXT
Starts the clock, or stops it, and restarts the count from the beginning either way
Restarts the count from the beginning and fires the RST output, without stopping the clock

inputs.text: Patch a clock here and the module follows it instead of its own tempo, passing its pulses on and deriving the half and double speed outputs from the measured interval
A rising edge restarts the count from the beginning and fires the RST output
A rising edge starts the clock and restarts the count from the beginning
A rising edge stops the clock and restarts the count from the beginning

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 1ms long on every quarter note
A 10V pulse 1ms long on every other quarter note
A 10V pulse 1ms long twice per quarter note
A 10V pulse 10ms long whenever the clock is reset, by the button or by the RST input

notes: the clock is running when the module is first placed, so pulses start arriving straight away
with a clock at EXT, the displayed tempo is measured from the incoming pulses; it is shown only once two edges have arrived and only between 20 and 400 BPM
menu: 1 PPQN (Submit standard) — treats one pulse as one quarter note, at EXT and at the outputs alike
4 PPQN (compatibility) — treats four pulses as one quarter note, at EXT and at the outputs alike
